title: Clover Leaf Egg, 1 dollar
descriptionPlain: Description Edition inspired by one of Fabergé’s most precious eggs Symbol of good luck and prosperity in an elegant setting Form rooted in the tradition of master goldsmithing One of the most personal Fabergé creations — gifted as a symbol of love and hope, adorned with a clover motif long associated with good fortune. The delicate intertwining of leaves with refined ornamentation reflects perfect harmony and artisanal precision. This silver coin draws attention with its noble form and detailing inspired by classic jewelry craftsmanship.
